allies.rationale_text: Feynman-technique helps expose bias-blind-spot by forcing simple explanation that reveals what is only being defended, not actually understood.
allies.affinity_rationale: Indirect diagnostic tool — forces simple explanation that reveals hidden assumptions and partial understanding, but operates at the knowledge level rather than directly addressing meta-awareness of one's own biases.
allies.activation_condition: When self-assessment of reasoning quality needs to be tested by attempting simple explanation that surfaces hidden assumptions and gaps in understanding

allies.rationale_text: Intellectual-humility is a natural ally because bias-blind-spot correction starts with genuine worry that your own judgment may be distorted.
allies.affinity_rationale: Bias-blind-spot correction starts with the disposition to genuinely worry that one might not be seeing things optimally — 'radical open-mindedness' IS the prerequisite for recognizing one's own blind spots.
allies.activation_condition: When the individual needs to genuinely worry that their own reasoning may contain blind spots before any metacognitive correction or self-examination can begin

allies.rationale_text: Critical-thinking supports bias-blind-spot correction by shifting the target of scrutiny from other people's stories to the evidence behind your own.
allies.source_quote: seek objective reality outside of our subjective perception
allies.affinity_rationale: Directional shift — 'seek objective reality outside of our subjective perception' — supports BBS correction by turning analytical scrutiny inward, but is a general capability rather than a BBS-specific mechanism.
allies.activation_condition: When the default critical stance is directed outward at others' reasoning and needs to be deliberately turned inward to examine one's own susceptibility to bias

antagonists.rationale_text: Confirmation-bias is reinforced by bias-blind-spot when self-unaware reasoning seeks support for existing conclusions while overlooking disconfirming information.
antagonists.source_quote: The BBS provides the foundation for confirmation bias
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Constitutive enabling — 'The BBS provides the foundation for confirmation bias' — bias-blind-spot is what makes confirmation bias invisible to the person exhibiting it, a foundational rather than merely synergistic relationship.
antagonists.activation_condition: When the inability to see one's own biases provides the psychological foundation for selectively seeking confirming evidence without any awareness of doing so

antagonists.rationale_text: Rationalization amplifies bias-blind-spot because smart interpreters can generate presentable reasons that defend the story they already prefer.
antagonists.source_quote: searching memory for presentable reasons to justify them
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Specific post-hoc mechanism — 'searching memory for presentable reasons to justify' decisions — intelligence amplifies BBS by enabling more sophisticated justification of bias-driven conclusions.
antagonists.activation_condition: When intelligent reasoning capacity is being used to generate plausible-sounding justifications for decisions that were actually driven by unrecognized biases

structured_tensions.tension_text: Bias-blind-spot conflicts with confirmation-bias when self-unaware reasoning reinforces the preferred conclusion while treating disconfirming evidence as less real.
structured_tensions.source_quote: The BBS provides the foundation for confirmation bias

curation_notes.summary: Layer 1+2 enrichment complete. Antagonists: confirmation-bias 0.95 (critical — 'provides the foundation'), rationalization 0.90 (strong — sophisticated post-hoc justification). Activation conditions assigned.
